declarations.name: AuiCascader
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI Cascader: `<aui-cascader>`.
Implements ControlValueAccessor and Validator (error key `aui`); `[(value)]` without forms.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Visible label; names the trigger and the popup.

inputs.name: hideLabel
inputs.description: Visually hide the label.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Help text, referenced by the trigger.

inputs.name: options
inputs.description: The tree { value, label, children?, isLeaf?, disabled? }; sibling values are unique.

inputs.name: multiple
inputs.description: Select several paths, shown as removable chips.

inputs.name: changeOnSelect
inputs.description: Any node can be selected, not only leaves.

inputs.name: loadChildren
inputs.description: Loads a node's children when it opens; aborted when the popup closes.

inputs.name: searchable
inputs.description: Show a search box in the popup.

inputs.name: maxResults
inputs.description: Maximum search results (1 to 1000).

inputs.name: levelLabels
inputs.description: Accessible names of the levels (default Level 1, Level 2, ...).

inputs.name: placeholder
inputs.description: Trigger text when nothing is selected (default Select).

inputs.name: clearable
inputs.description: Show a clear button for a single selection that is not required.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Form field name: one hidden input per path with its leaf value.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: A selection is required.

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: Disable the control.

inputs.name: readOnly
inputs.description: Show the value; the popup does not open.

inputs.name: validate
inputs.description: Consumer validation; return a message to mark the value invalid.

inputs.name: icons
inputs.description: Icon overrides.

inputs.name: validationTiming
inputs.description: When validation messages appear.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Locale of messages and search matching.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: Reading direction for arrow keys and popup alignment.

models.name: value
models.description: The value: `[(value)]` without forms; with Angular forms, bind the form control instead.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: The selection changed: { value, labels, validity }.

properties.name: formState
properties.description: Angular form state of this control.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Open the popup and focus the search box (or the first level).

methods.name: close
methods.description: Close the popup; pending loads are aborted.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: Show or clear an external error.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial value and clear messages.

accessibility.pattern: A select-only combobox (a button element with role=combobox and aria-haspopup="dialog") opens a non-modal dialog (WAI-ARIA APG Dialog, non-modal variant) that holds a search box and one WAI-ARIA APG Listbox per level. Levels behave like the columns of a column browser: Up and Down move within a level, the inline arrow keys move between levels. A tree view was not used because only one branch per level is shown at a time.

limitations: Search only finds nodes that are loaded (given in options or loaded earlier); it does not call loadChildren.
A value whose path is not loaded yet shows the raw values for the unknown segments until those levels load.
Columns are not windowed; very long levels (thousands of options) should be loaded lazily or split.
